semiconductor_relevance: High — Hwa Shu Enterprise Co., Ltd. specializes in precision mold fabrication and plastic injection molding specifically for the semiconductor packaging and testing industry.
summary: Hwa Shu Enterprise Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of IC trays, Tape & Reel, and chip trays, serving the semiconductor packaging and testing industry. Established in 1982, the company has expanded its product offerings and customer base significantly, particularly in the Asia-Pacific region.
